_comment: Declarative experiment matrix for RepairBench. Each experiment is one cell of the model x repair-signal grid. `signal` is a list of extra levers on top of the tool diagnostic: 'spec' (intent) and/or 'locate' (oracle line). `anon` strips the VerilogEval identity (leak-free floor). Endpoints: served models read $RTLREPAIR_LLM_URL; set `endpoint_env` to route an experiment at a different served endpoint (e.g. a separate OriGen vLLM server). Claude reads $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

experiments._note: the two cells missing from Table 2 — completes the model x signal cross
experiments.name: v5_diag_spec

experiments._note: the purpose-built repair model. OriGen's native template requires a description, so it is a diagnostic+spec arm. Serve DeepSeek-Coder-7B + the OriGen_Fix LoRA via vLLM and point endpoint_env at it.
experiments.name: origen_diag_spec

experiments._note: VeriReason (CodeLlama-7B GRPO reasoning), served on Modal (backend/modal_inference/). Native contract is spec->RTL generation, NOT repair, so repair is off-distribution under any prompt: numbers are lower bounds. The default-style arm is the strict-parity floor (generic prompt, 1024 tokens; expect truncation of think-first output — label as floor). Native arms use the think/answer template at 2048 tokens (VERIREASON_MAX_TOKENS).
experiments.name: verireason_default_diag

experiments._note: Nellyw888/Qwen2.5-7B-Verilog-RTLCoder-GRPO-reasoning-simple -- same GRPO reasoning recipe as VeriReason but on Qwen2.5-7B instead of CodeLlama-7B. Served with the stock Qwen ChatML template (its trained-on format), so no raw-completion override. Emits full <think>/<answer> incl. closing tags.
experiments.name: vrqwen_diag
